skills.description: UXArmy (uxarmy.com) platform help — a self-serve user-research and usability-testing suite: unmoderated tests with screen/audio recording and full-journey heatmaps, DeepDive moderated interviews / dyads / triads / focus groups, open/closed/hybrid card sorting, tree testing, surveys, and AI auto-tagging / follow-ups / sentiment. UI-only — no public API, webhooks, Zapier, or MCP; data leaves via export or the Slack / Figma / Google Sheets integrations. Use when running a card sort or tree test to fix navigation, recruiting testers in Asia-Pacific markets, estimating how many credits a study will burn, hitting the free plan's credit ceiling, or choosing between UXArmy and UXtweak / Lyssna / Maze. Do NOT use for the research-tool landscape or validate-before-building (use /sales-idea-validation).
